unreg:race_to_n_points.blueprint_mechanism: Margin follows opponent-adjusted efficiency and tempo, shifted by home court, neutral-site and travel effects and, importantly, by who plays. CBB ratings are noisier than NBA ratings (fewer games, roster churn), so uncertainty and market-implied information matter, and variance depends on tempo and three-point reliance. Disclosure of availability is sparse, so edge lies in scenario mixtures and rating uncertainty.

KXNCAAMBCONFLEADER.rules_primary: If Zoom Diallo records the most points per game in the Southeastern Conference in the entire 2026-27 Division I men's college basketball season, including postseason, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNCAAMBCONFLEADER.rules_secondary:
NCAA minimum qualification thresholds apply.
This market uses statistics for the entire 2026-27 season, including the postseason. Counts all official regular-season games, both conference and nonconference, including in-season tournaments; conference-tournament games; and NCAA Tournament games, including the Opening Round and the championship game. NIT games and games in other official postseason competitions (including the College Basketball Crown, CBI, or CIT, when held) also count. Exhibition and preseason games that are clearly designated as unofficial do not count.
